user.title: Referenzmarktwert PV
user.description: Calculates the Austrian reference market value (§ 13 EAG) from Energy-Charts data (CC BY 4.0) and E-Control's official values. The data sources are preset; open the section only to change them.

data_description.deduction: Subtracted from the market value for the payout sensors (Hofer Sonne: 0.015 EUR/kWh).

data_description.energy_charts_url: Base URL of the Energy-Charts API.
data_description.generation_path: Endpoint for generation data, relative to the API URL.
data_description.price_path: Endpoint for day-ahead prices, relative to the API URL.
data_description.country: Energy-Charts country code for the generation data, e.g. at.
data_description.bidding_zone: Energy-Charts bidding zone for the prices, e.g. AT.
data_description.production_type: Name of the generation type in the Energy-Charts data, e.g. Solar.
data_description.header_name: Optional, e.g. for an API key. Sent with every Energy-Charts request.
data_description.econtrol_url: URL of E-Control's history file of the official values (xlsx).
data_description.econtrol_header_name: Optional. Sent with every E-Control download.
data_description.econtrol_month_column: Column of the month in the E-Control file.
data_description.econtrol_value_column: Column of the technology's value (D = photovoltaics).
data_description.econtrol_base_column: Column of the day-ahead base price (for the estimate). Empty: not used.
data_description.time_zone: Months are counted in this time zone.

data.prior_method: Estimate for the rest of the month
data.official_early_interval_hours: Official values: check interval while awaited

data_description.deduction: Subtracted from the market value for the payout sensors (Hofer Sonne: 0.015 EUR/kWh).
data_description.prior_method: How the not yet known part of the month is estimated.
data_description.aggregation_seconds: E-Control weights hourly values (3600 s). 900 s only for comparison.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often new generation data is downloaded between sunrise and sunset (plus the offsets below).
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Generation is downloaded from this long after sunrise (Home Assistant's home location).
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: ... until this long after sunset. Energy-Charts lags about 2 h behind real time.
data_description.overlap_hours: Each download repeats the last hours, in case values arrived late or were corrected.
data_description.full_refresh_time: Once a night the whole running month is downloaded again (local time).
data_description.price_time: Day-ahead prices are published once a day (about 13:00); they are looked for from this time on.
data_description.price_retry_minutes: How often to look again until tomorrow's prices are there.
data_description.official_interval_hours: How often the E-Control file is checked. It is only downloaded if it changed.
data_description.official_early_interval_hours: Used at the start of the month while last month's value is not published yet.
data_description.official_early_days: Until this day of the month the shorter interval is used (published so far: day 2-14).
data_description.request_delay_seconds: Energy-Charts limits how often it may be asked.

options.base_x_capture_rate: Base price × last year's capture rate (recommended)

energy_charts_deprecated.title: Energy-Charts API will be retired
energy_charts_deprecated.description: Energy-Charts marks the API endpoints this integration uses as deprecated. They keep working for at least six months after the announcement; please update the Referenzmarktwert integration in that time (or report it in its issue tracker if no update is available).
